section.54: The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

54.name_native: The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

hadiths.text: Ibn Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while pointing his hands towards the east: The turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side (he repeated it thrice) where appear the horns of Satan
